# Sunofriend interface contract

<!-- Generated by sunofriend.interface_contract; do not edit by hand. -->

Contract version: `2026-08-18.1`

The Guided Local Studio TUI is the preferred human entry point. It
opens in Simple mode by default; `sunofriend tui --mode studio` opens
the detailed comparison workspace first. Its visible Simple/Studio
switch changes views in either direction and remembers the last
Studio tab without starting work or changing project state. The
expert CLI and agent skill
remain supported and share the public commands below.

## Source preparation

`sunofriend source-doctor` inspects an existing local FFmpeg/FFprobe
toolchain without writing files.

`sunofriend musical-metadata SOURCE` estimates key, BPM and tuning
locally without changing the source. Its path-free JSON evidence is
automatic, not reviewed, and retains half/double-time and key
alternatives. High-confidence key/BPM values may fill missing import
metadata but never replace explicit or filename/folder values.

`sunofriend source-import` preserves exactly one authorised local
audio asset as immutable original evidence plus canonical PCM24 WAV.
It does not create stems or make a complete Simple/Studio project.

`sunofriend source-import-folder` prepares 2–64 already-separated,
synchronized top-level audio parts as one fresh canonical WAV stem
project. Plan mode is read-only. Execution never separates, shifts,
pads, stretches, normalizes or musically aligns audio. Compatible
recorded origins are evidence, not proof of a downbeat or musical
alignment. For separated stems, `--metadata-source` binds the original
finished mix used for automatic key/BPM evidence.

`sunofriend create` and TUI Simple/Studio consume a prepared project
of synchronized top-level WAV stems to make MIDI, a MIDI-derived
song-interpretation WAV and a GarageBand handoff. Preparing a folder
and converting it are separate actions.

`sunofriend song-generate REFERENCE --lyrics LYRICS --style DESCRIPTION`
plans one reference-conditioned full-song request. It uses separate
0-1 reference and style-description strength controls and requests two
complete candidates. Add `--generation-mode remix` to use ACE-Step's
native `cover` task instead of the default creative-reference mode.
Native remix uses the reference as editable source audio, accepts
replacement lyrics and locks duration to the source; it does not claim
independent BPM, key, meter or duration overrides. Planning is read-only.
Execution requires both `--execute` and `--confirm-rights`, writes only
to a fresh destination and retains a hash-bound request plus success or
failure receipt. The adapter streams the role-correct audio as multipart
upload to an existing ACE-Step API; it neither installs nor starts the
model service. No candidate is selected, separated, converted to MIDI or
admitted to a final mix automatically.

`sunofriend song-providers` prints the secret-free provider capability
registry without network access. Only providers registered for the full
reference-conditioned contract may appear in `song-generate --backend`.
Evaluated cloud APIs may remain visible but ineligible when they cannot
honour reference audio or both independent strength controls. Cloud
providers must use a user-supplied environment key, explicit terms/cost
acknowledgement and immediate local archiving; never send a shared key to
browser JavaScript.

Finished-mix separation has four deliberately distinct lanes:

1. public default `broad-vocals-v1`: broad vocals plus complementary
   instrumental;
2. public explicit opt-in `core-four-stems-v1`: SCNet vocals, drums,
   bass and grouped other;
3. private research: unregistered Mega-53 synth and BS-RoFormer-SW
   guitar reconciled with core four into six mutually exclusive roles; and
4. private recovery: a model-free full-song listening package whose
   guitar guard/resource evidence is incomplete and which is not objective
   qualification or a public product.

`sunofriend vocal-comp-create` admits 2-24 synchronized local vocal-only
WAV takes, canonical lyrics, one reviewed monophonic target MIDI and a
reviewed musical-phrase timeline into an immutable private project. It
requires explicit rights, common-recorded-zero and target-review
confirmations. `--plan` writes nothing. `sunofriend vocal-comp-analyze`
then preserves independent pYIN and Basic Pitch evidence, optionally
consumes separately completed matching RMVPE evidence, and publishes
transparent target-relative phrase rankings, top-three local auditions
and a pickup plan. This experimental increment gives expression zero
ranking weight, uses the AI reference only when no human take clears the
fixed evidence floor, and cannot select, tune or render a vocal comp.
`sunofriend vocal-comp-draft-review` creates a private local listening
page for automatic lyrics, phrase timing and target MIDI. Playback and
visible defaults grant no authority. Every phrase requires explicit
lyrics/timing and melody approval. The page exports private JSON; only
`sunofriend vocal-comp-draft-resolve` can bind one exact complete review
to fresh reviewed inputs. An unresolved review changes nothing.
`sunofriend vocal-comp-draft-feedback` preserves one exact unresolved
export as private development evidence without promoting lyrics, timing,
target melody, take selection, audio rendering or correction.
`sunofriend vocal-comp-word-align` binds local word-timestamp STT JSON
to its exact AI/human vocal and globally aligns it to canonical lyrics.
It exposes insertions as ad-lib candidates, omissions and substitutions
as uncertain review items, and cannot rewrite lyrics. Syllable timing
remains explicitly unavailable until singing-oriented phoneme evidence
is supplied and reviewed.
`sunofriend vocal-comp-stt` runs unprompted local OpenAI Whisper word
timestamps only from an exact existing checkpoint and interpreter. It
has no model-name download fallback, prompts with no canonical lyrics,
runs with offline environment flags and remains auxiliary unreviewed
evidence for `vocal-comp-word-align`.
`sunofriend vocal-comp-word-review` creates a hash-bound private page
with full-source context, shared ad-lib and lyric-line excerpts, STT
differences, detailed source feedback and explicit JSON export. Playback
and browser drafts create no decision; the page cannot select a take,
approve target melody, render audio or apply correction.

The separate `sunofriend-separate` entry point estimates stems from
one authorised finished mix on a supported Apple-silicon Mac. Broad
vocals plus complementary instrumental remains the default. The
immutable SCNet-large profile is now a public opt-in preview for vocals,
drums, bass and grouped other. Its exact runtime, checkpoint and source
identity passed compatibility and inference checks under network denial.

resource-supervised. The earlier MLX baseline and PyTorch fallback remain
blocked after their bounded objective remediations failed.
Results are local, experimental and unreviewed for musical usefulness.
No separated output enters MIDI conversion automatically.
`sunofriend-separate profiles` exposes exact status. Blocked profiles
cannot run. Poor musical feedback is valid
evidence, not an admission veto or an unlimited tuning trigger.

## Product outputs

Sunofriend produces two linked creative outputs:

- **Editable MIDI arrangement** (`evaluated_editable_midi`)
- **MIDI-derived song-interpretation WAV** (`midi_derived_song_interpretation_wav`)

### Two honest operating modes

- **Simple / Make my song:** automatic editable MIDI, named starter sounds, balanced MIDI-derived WAV and starter ZIP. It uses
  exact production-summary primaries, is marked automatic and
  unreviewed, writes no human decision or feedback event, and
  recommends Studio review.
  It also publishes separately labelled starter-sound MIDI, named
  General MIDI assignments, short per-part previews and a GarageBand
  instrument guide while leaving every automatic-primary MIDI exact.
- **Studio:** reviewed editable MIDI, balanced MIDI-derived WAV and exact GarageBand handoff. Choices and feedback are
  recorded only after an explicit human action.

The song-interpretation WAV is rendered only from explicitly
selected MIDI in Studio or separately labelled automatic-primary
MIDI in Simple mode. Source stems provide timing, render-horizon
and level evidence but are not mixed into it. Interpolation means
a creative MIDI interpretation, not waveform reconstruction.

The optional listening master is a comparative artifact, not a
human-approved release master. Playback, metrics and visible
defaults never imply a preference.

Ordinary Workbench and the Guided Local Studio Master tab can
explicitly build or reuse a separate fixed-policy
listening-master challenger from the exact current balanced
control. The gain-only control remains unchanged; the operation
records no feedback or preference and changes no MIDI, selection,
default or GarageBand pack.

Workbench can then prepare one exact 0.5–15 second blinded,
fixed-window sample-RMS-matched control-versus-challenger review.
Only explicit completion records a separate local feedback
artifact; a second explicit action reveals the A/B assignment.
Neither action promotes an artifact or changes MIDI, selection,
ranking, product completion, defaults or the GarageBand pack.

## Guided entry points

Direct guided TUI actions in the current increment:

- `sunofriend doctor`
- `sunofriend listen-all`
- `sunofriend listening-master`
- `sunofriend tui`
- `sunofriend vocal-melody`
- `sunofriend workbench`

Every other command remains available through the expert CLI while
typed TUI operation forms are added incrementally.
